QuestInfo.name: Arwen the Fairy's Request
QuestInfo.0: #p1032100# said that the fruit you brought really brightened her day. You wonder what could have made her so down in the first place...
QuestInfo.1: #p1032100# said she lost her favorite #bGlass Shoes#k. Apparently, they got stuck in a #r#o1210103##k and popped right off her feet. Gross. You might be able to find her shoes by hunting #r#o1210103#s#k. #r#o1210103#s#k can be found at the #b#m101020100##k.
QuestInfo.2: #p1032100# was overjoyed to have her #t4033017# back. #p1032100# gave you some equipment out of gratitude.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary: EXP 600 #Wbasic# #i1002017:# #t1002017:# x 1 Can proceed to the Exchanging Greetings with Wing quest

0.0: Boy, that orange really hit the spot. I needed a little pick-me-up like that, since... Hey, do you think you could help me?

yes.0: How kind you are! It's just a little thing, but... Some time ago, I left #m101000000# to play, and bumped into a group of human hunters. I didn't notice at the time, but I lost my favorite #bGlass Shoes#k.
yes.1: And those humans didn't even bother to say sorry! They just ran past as if nothing happened. Stupid human jerks! ...Not you though. You're cool.
yes.2: Anyway, my #bGlass Shoes#k fell off the tree, and I couldn't find them anywhere. I think the #r#o1210103#s#k might have eaten them. It will make me really happy if you could get my #bGlass Shoes#k back from the #r#o1210103#s#k. The #r#o1210103#s#k are near #b#m101020100##k.

no.0: Hmph! I should've expected as much from a human! You don't know anything about helping!

1.0: My favorite pair of shoes... *Sniff*\r\nHuh? You found them! Thank you so much!

yes.0: Boy, you're so much nicer than the other people I've met! You brought me fruit and my shoes and were just really cool in general. Here, I want to give you this. You deserve it, you cool person, you!

item.0: My favorite pair of shoes... *Sniff* My #bGlass Shoes#k are probably with the #r#o1210103#s#k, and the #r#o1210103#s#k can be found at the #b#m101020100##k. Don't leave my shoes with them!
